from parking import fee


def test_a_short_stay_is_free():
    assert fee(20) == 0


def test_each_started_hour_costs_2():
    assert fee(150) == 6
EOF
/private/tmp/msr104-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_parking.py 2>&1 | tail -5
cat > parking.py <<'EOF'
FREE_MINUTES = 30
RATE_PER_HOUR = 2


def fee(minutes: int) -> int:
    if minutes <= FREE_MINUTES:
        return 0
    started_hours = -(-minutes // 60)
    return RATE_PER_HOUR * started_hours
EOF
/private/tmp/msr104-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_parking.py 2>&1 | tail -5
git add parking.py tests/test_parking.py; git commit -q -m "Add the parking fee" -m "Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"; git log --oneline | head -2
